name: defense-in-depth

args.prompt: Edit ONLY the diagram stroke colors in the FIRST image, preserving every pixel-position arrangement, every arrow and branch, all exact natural photos and counts, all empty white interiors, all outline neural nodes and outline icons. Use the second and third images as QUIET MUTED color references. Current blue and red outlines are too saturated. The entire scientific diagram must look calm, grayish and restrained: slate gray-blue (target #7188A3), dusty sage gray-green (#829C8B), muted khaki gray-yellow (#B4A16F), dusty gray-rose (#A7787D), gray-lavender (#9588A5), dark neutral gray wires (#4C4D4F). NOT royal blue, bright cyan, vivid green, wine red, or bright red. Keep all non-photographic interiors perfectly white and flat; no new colored fill, gradient, glow, texture, bevel or shadow. No text, letters, labels or numbers. Preserve topology, counts, positions and aspect ratio exactly. This is a stroke-color-only refinement of the first image; do not reintroduce filled nodes or modify any photo.

hint:
Generated images are saved to /Users/robbieshi/.codex/generated_images/01a12a9b-1479-70a0-a390-21b15b514cbb as /Users/robbieshi/.codex/generated_images/01a12a9b-1479-70a0-a390-21b15b514cbb/exec-de424fe0-19c4-47ce-9764-0d04608f00ae.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
